headline: Lincoln's two minutes at Gettysburg
post_facts: Everett spoke for two hours first

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in eighteen sixty-three... Abraham Lincoln gave a speech that lasted about two minutes.

scenes.label: Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
scenes.caption: Crowd at the cemetery dedication
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He came to dedicate a cemetery for the soldiers of Gettysburg.

scenes.label: the speaker before Lincoln talked
scenes.text: [calmly] The main speaker, Edward Everett, talked for about two hours.

scenes.label: Abraham Lincoln
scenes.caption: Photo by Alexander Gardner, 1863
scenes.text: [softly] Lincoln used fewer than three hundred words.

scenes.title: A new birth of freedom
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Today, they rank among America's most famous words.

scenes.title: Can you recite the first line?
scenes.text: [gently] Can you recite its first line?
